search_objective: Identify authoritative sources reporting influenza (flu) cases, deaths, hospitalizations, and surveillance data for the United States during the week of 2024-09-29 to 2024-10-05. Priority is CDC FluView weekly surveillance reports, followed by WHO/PAHO international reports, structured surveillance databases, and news coverage for the specific time window.
search_reasoning: The time window (2024-09-29 to 2024-10-05) falls at the very start of the 2024-2025 U.S. influenza season (CDC flu season typically begins week 40, which starts around early October). The CDC FluView system is the primary authoritative source for weekly U.S. influenza surveillance data, reporting by MMWR week. Week 40 of 2024 (ending Oct 5, 2024) is the most relevant reporting period. Queries must target: (1) CDC FluView week 40 2024 reports, (2) CDC influenza surveillance season start 2024-2025, (3) WHO/PAHO global influenza updates covering the US for that period, (4) news/media reports on flu season start October 2024. The upstream queries used overly broad quoted phrases and date-range strings that are unlikely to match real document text; this iteration replaces them with operationally precise queries aligned to how CDC and WHO actually title and structure their reports (MMWR week numbers, season designations, FluView terminology).
